blocks.category: Chemical Peels — PCA Skin Professional Protocols

items.name: Brightening Peel
items.detail: PCA Skin Sensi Peel or Pigment Gel Peel. Targets hyperpigmentation, sun damage, and uneven tone. Minimal downtime; suitable for all Fitzpatrick skin types including sensitive and darker complexions.

items.name: Anti-Aging Retinol Peel
items.detail: PCA Skin Ultra Peel I or Retinol Treatment for Wrinkles. Smooths texture, reduces fine lines, and stimulates collagen synthesis. Expect 3–5 days of mild peeling.

items.name: Acne Clarifying Peel
items.detail: PCA Skin Acne/Oily Skin Treatment. Salicylic and kojic acid blend to reduce active breakouts, minimize pore appearance, and regulate oil production.

items.name: Advanced Resurfacing Peel
items.detail: PCA Skin Ultra Peel Forte or Modified Jessner. Deeper resurfacing for stubborn texture, acne scarring, or advanced photoaging. Allow 5–7 days downtime. Provider-assessed; requires prior peel history on file.

notes: A provider consultation is required prior to any treatment, including your first peel service. VIP discounts apply to all facial and peel services. Results may vary based on individual skin type and condition.
